# Steam — longstanding kidnapping progression reports

- Original source: [Bug - Secuestro de Robin Hood](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/discussions/0/3008934419482734392/)
- Author / publication: Bancrofth and respondents; Steam Community.
- Language / date: Spanish with English and Russian replies; opened 2021-01-11, last reply 2024-10-25.
- Access: Opening post and all 16 comments retrieved directly across both pages.
- Checked / retrieved: 2026-09-09.

## English translation

### Opening post — Bancrofth — 11 January 2021, 10:58 a.m.

**Bug — Robin Hood kidnapping**

No matter how far I advance in the side missions, they never give me the mission to rescue Robin from his kidnapping. I started from scratch and had the same problem. Is there any solution?

### Comment 1 — Markdroop — 28 January 2021, 5:35 p.m.

Hello, were you able to solve it?

### Comment 2 — Bancrofth — 29 January 2021, 7:47 a.m.

Hello, no /: I have not been able to fix it.

### Comment 3 — Sebast — 23 February 2021, 3:28 p.m.

The same thing happens to me; I have restarted the missions several times and am stuck at 63%.

### Comment 4 — водитель лошади — 21 March 2021, 5:53 a.m.

How can I stop the game from lagging on Windows 10?

### Comment 5 — Bancrofth — 2 April 2021, 5:34 p.m.

In reply to the lag question:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cykBJw_gwOI>

### Comment 6 — Xiño — 20 August 2022, 4:43 p.m.

I do not know about the Steam version, but on the GOG version it worked for me to play the previous mission, the one with the black guards, in English; that way I was able to start the rescue, and then changed it to Spanish.

### Comment 7 — Nobutora — 15 October 2022, 9:41 a.m.

In reply to the opening post: The only solution is to change the game language to English. It seems there is a bug with that mission when the language is Spanish that they never got around to fixing.

### Comment 8 — Janissary — 14 April 2023, 1:34 p.m.

I think you should play the English version of the game. I used to play the French version and had the same problem.

### Comment 9 — Nobutora — 4 May 2023, 10:33 a.m.

You have to change the game language to English; for some reason there is a bug that prevents progress.

### Comment 10 — indornevada670 — 9 May 2023, 10:11 p.m.

In reply to Nobutora: And how do you change the game language to English? I do not know how to do it, and the game does not give you the option. :(

### Comment 11 — xd4n1x — 13 May 2023, 9:04 a.m.

Strange, I have never had this problem, perhaps because I play in Italian.

### Comment 12 — Nobutora — 22 June 2023, 5:47 a.m.

In reply to indornevada670: Right-click the Robin Hood game, then choose Properties; under General you will see the languages.

### Comment 13 — juapo520 — 15 April 2024, 8:49 a.m.

When I change the language, my saved games do not appear, and when I change it back to Spanish, the one I saved does not appear either.

### Comment 14 — Flacolas — 13 July 2024, 10:14 p.m.

In reply to Xiño: What is the GOG version?

### Comment 15 — Flacolas — 13 July 2024, 10:15 p.m.

Hello, I tried changing the language, but my progress did not appear; when I returned to Spanish, I lost all my progress. I no longer know what to do, even if I want to recover my old progress. Does anyone have a solution?

### Comment 16 — Ghost DIEGO MOMOX — 25 October 2024, 7:30 p.m.

Quoted instructions from Nobutora (comment 12), including the earlier question and answer:

> And how do you change the game language to English? I do not know how to do it, and the game does not give you the option. :(
>
> Right-click the Robin Hood game, then choose Properties; under General you will see the languages.

There is no option like that anywhere; all the entries look the same and none of them mentions a language.

### Coverage notes

The original text is available and complete for the opening post and all 16 comments across the two retrieved pages. Steam navigation, login controls, unrelated discussion recommendations, report controls, and legal/footer chrome were removed. The English section translates every substantive post and quoted passage; the original Spanish, Russian, and English text is preserved below it.
